# Dairy-Free Cheesy Foods That Every Part of You Feels Good About

## Cheese Reimagined

Can you imagine a life without cheese? Sounds impossible, right? Now, picture a plant-based cheese
that's irresistibly rich and satisfyingly creamy. With us, it's not just possible — it's a
guarantee. You'll never have to live without the joy of cheese again.

#### Melty

#### Creamy

#### Stretchy

#### Cheesy
* ### Unbelievable Melt, Pure Indulgence
  
  Get ready for a melt that'll make you melt! Daiya's dairy-free cheese is a game-changer, melting
  flawlessly for that ooey-gooey satisfaction you love. Thanks to our Daiya Oat Cream™ blend, each
  bite is a creamy, dreamy delight. Who knew plant-based could taste this good and melt so right?

Dairy-Free Non-GMO No FOMO

## Cheese Bliss

Is there any comfort food more iconic than cheese? Our new dairy-free cheese melts impeccably,
offering a mouthwatering experience that stands out on its own… minus the actual dairy. Try melty,
mouthwatering shreds, slices, sticks, and more – all made extra delicious with the first-ever Daiya
Oat Cream™️ blend. Explore the whole starting lineup right here.
[ Discover Cheese ][40]

### Pizza Perfection

Why can't every night be pizza night? With Daiya, it can be! Each bite of our pizza is plant-based
perfection: featuring a crisp, thin crust, melty dairy-free cheese, and a perfectly balanced amount
of toppings.

[ Explore Pizza & Flatbread ][41]

### Mac & Cheese Magic

Mac & Cheese is *peak* nostalgia. Our dairy-free Mac & Cheese is no exception, incredibly melty,
exceptionally creamy, and bursting with rich cheesy goodness. One bite and you'll be transported
back to simpler times.

[ Explore Mac & Cheese ][42]

## The Daiya Way
* Inclusive Indulgence
  
  ### Deliciously Easy, Incredibly Cheesy
  
  Maybe it's our Pacific Northwest roots, maybe it's just being realistic, but at Daiya, we're about
  creating delicious moments that everyone can feel good about—plant-devotees, the plant-curious,
  and cheese aficionados alike. We're bridging the gap with our Daiya Oat Cream™ blend, ensuring
  that choosing Daiya means indulging in creamy, melty, and rich flavors crafted from plants. This
  is comfort food meant to be relished by all. So, let's raise a toast to a world where cheese
  doesn't come with conditions, and every bite is a celebration of taste and choice.
  
  [Discover Our Story][43]

## Confessions from Cheese Lovers Anonymous
* "Your pizza is legit amazing. I’m so impressed!"
* "I recognize that this must have taken a while to achieve. Kudos to Daiya for making it happen!"
* "I just had your new chicken, smoked bacon, ranch flavored flatbread and loved it!"
* "We just finished enjoying (yet) another of your delicious pizzas, and I felt moved to send you
  some love."

Previous
Next

## Daiya in the Press
* "It's tough to nail the cheesy consistency without dairy, but Daiya delivers on taste and
  texture."
* "We're not mad about the Vegan, which knocks it out of the park with Daiya cheese."
* "Daiya, the king of vegan cheeses, prized for its realistic melting characteristics and 'cheesy'
  flavor."
* "These taste surprisingly similar to real cheese (but not exactly the same, obviously)."

## Meet Us IRL

No matter which one you choose, our Dry Powdered Mac & Cheese are bringing the vibes! Which flavor
are you going for? #daiyacheese #daiyafoods #dairyfreecheese #plantbasedcheese

[ @daiyafoods ][44]

Don’t be shy, come say hi and grab some cheesy snacks 🧀 Daiya’s Dairy-Free Dairy Tour is on and
we’d love to see you there! #daiyacheese #dairyfreedairytour #dairyfreecheese

[ @daiyafoods ][45]

🥒 Recipe inspired by @logansfewd #cucumbersalad #viralrecipe

# Dairy-Free Cheesy Foods That Every Part of You Feels Good About

## Cheese Reimagined

Can you imagine a life without cheese? Sounds impossible, right? Now, picture a plant-based cheese
that's irresistibly rich and satisfyingly creamy. With us, it's not just possible — it's a
guarantee. You'll never have to live without the joy of cheese again.

#### Melty

#### Creamy

#### Stretchy

#### Cheesy
* ### Unbelievable Melt, Pure Indulgence
  
  Get ready for a melt that'll make you melt! Daiya's dairy-free cheese is a game-changer, melting
  flawlessly for that ooey-gooey satisfaction you love. Thanks to our Daiya Oat Cream™ blend, each
  bite is a creamy, dreamy delight. Who knew plant-based could taste this good and melt so right?

Dairy-Free Non-GMO No FOMO

## Cheese Bliss

Is there any comfort food more iconic than cheese? Our new dairy-free cheese melts impeccably,
offering a mouthwatering experience that stands out on its own… minus the actual dairy. Try melty,
mouthwatering shreds, slices, sticks, and more – all made extra delicious with the first-ever Daiya
Oat Cream™️ blend. Explore the whole starting lineup right here.
[ Discover Cheese ][40]

### Pizza Perfection

Why can't every night be pizza night? With Daiya, it can be! Each bite of our pizza is plant-based
perfection: featuring a crisp, thin crust, melty dairy-free cheese, and a perfectly balanced amount
of toppings.

[ Explore Pizza & Flatbread ][41]

### Mac & Cheese Magic

Mac & Cheese is *peak* nostalgia. Our dairy-free Mac & Cheese is no exception, incredibly melty,
exceptionally creamy, and bursting with rich cheesy goodness. One bite and you'll be transported
back to simpler times.

[ Explore Mac & Cheese ][42]

## The Daiya Way
* Inclusive Indulgence
  
  ### Deliciously Easy, Incredibly Cheesy
  
  Maybe it's our Pacific Northwest roots, maybe it's just being realistic, but at Daiya, we're about
  creating delicious moments that everyone can feel good about—plant-devotees, the plant-curious,
  and cheese aficionados alike. We're bridging the gap with our Daiya Oat Cream™ blend, ensuring
  that choosing Daiya means indulging in creamy, melty, and rich flavors crafted from plants. This
  is comfort food meant to be relished by all. So, let's raise a toast to a world where cheese
  doesn't come with conditions, and every bite is a celebration of taste and choice.
  
  [Discover Our Story][43]

# Earth Balance^{®}

## Made For Everyone

From vegan buttery spreads and baking sticks to nut butters and other savory snacks, Earth Balance
vegan ingredients are really for everyone, so go ahead and get baking.

[ Buy Now ][13]
[ Nutrition Facts ][14]

non-gmo, plant-based, vegan

## About Earth Balance

[

### Who We Are

Our Colorado Roots

][15]

## Who We Are

### Our Colorado Roots

Born in Boulder, Colorado, in 1998, Earth Balance® started with a single innovative product: our
non-GMO, expeller-pressed Original Buttery Spread. This breakthrough creation gave vegans and food
lovers alike a chance to enjoy craveable, meltable, buttery goodness again.

We saw the joy brought by putting dairy-free buttery flavor on the menu for our plant-based eaters,
so we added more varieties to our line of spreads.

Then we came up with more delicious vegan baking products, like vegan buttery sticks, and began
offering vegan peanut butter spreads, adding variety in the grocery store–just for you. Today Earth
Balance offers spreads, sticks, nut butters, and snacks, all while remembering our humble
mountain-born beginnings.

[

### What We Believe

Our Food Philosophy

][16]

## What We Believe

### Our Food Philosophy

We believe in the power of Plant-Made. Basically, it means we make things from plants. But it means
other things, too, like integrity and mindfulness.

We know how important it is that plant-based baking, cooking, and snacking is accessible. That’s why
everything we make is vegan, meaning it's made using dairy-free ingredients and contains no animal
products.

[

### Did You Know?

We're Ethically Plant-Made

][17]

## Did You Know?

### We're Ethically Plant-Made

By making everything vegan and free of animal products, we make it easy to maintain a plant-based
food diet.

Many of our products are also Non-GMO Project Verified. Palm oil is a non-GMO, non-hydrogenated oil
we use to minimize separation in some of our products.

Any palm oil used in Earth Balance vegan products comes from Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil
(RSPO) member organizations, committed to environmentally and socially responsible palm oil
production. Our spreads are certified to the RSPO Mass Balance certification system¹.


*¹Conagra Brands began sourcing to the RSPO Mass Balance standards for spreads as of July 1, 2019.*

## We Love Feedback

Have a second? Let us know how you like our products.
Leave a Review

### A New Meaning to Plant-Based Eating

### Ordering FAQs

What are my shipping options?

We currently have three shipping options you can choose from!

1) Standard (3 - 7 business days, $5 flat rate shipping)
2) Expedited (2-5 business days, the rate will be calculated at checkout)
3) Priority (1-4 business days, the rate will be calculated at checkout)

Looks like you're out of stock... 

We are doing our best to maintain a steady supply of Ripple products for our online store. If we are
out of something, we are working as fast as we can to re-stock.

You can also now sign up for back in stock announcements! Put your email address into the product
you would like updates on, and we will be sure to email you as soon as we have more products
available for purchase. 

What is the status of my order?

After you’ve made a purchase, we'll send you two emails. First, your 'Order Confirmation' email will
be sent within minutes of placing the order to let you know that our system has accepted your order.
As soon as your order is on its way, you will receive a 'Shipping Confirmation' email with all the
necessary tracking information. If you don’t see a confirmation email in your inbox, please check
your SPAM folder. If you still have questions about your order status, feel free to email us at
DTC@ripplefoods.com.

Can I make changes to my order?

Due to all Ripple orders being processed immediately after an order is submitted, we cannot
guarantee any updates to your order after it has been confirmed. In rare cases if a mistake has
occurred, please email us at DTC@ripplefoods.com as soon as you can to increase the chances we are
able to make updates before the warehouse starts working on your shipment! 

Orders are processed at our warehouse 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Processing generally takes
24-48 hours; once your order has shipped from the warehouse, please allow 2-3 business days for your
delicious Ripple to arrive at your door

What is your refund policy?

We don't accept returns of product or product exchanges.

If your order was damaged in transit, or if you've received the wrong Ripple order, please reach out
to our customer service team by email: dtc@ripplefoods.com.

If you believe there is a quality issue with your Ripple order, please take note of the code and the
"best by" date printed on the bottle or carton, so that we can trace the specific batch of Ripple
you have received. These inquiries will be handled on a case-by-case basis.

What is a Ripple Subscription?

We offer ongoing subscriptions to customers who never want to run out of Ripple! Our subscriptions
are commitment-free and can be updated, edited, or canceled at any point in time.

To sign up, select the "subscription" option on the product page before checking out.

You have the option of receiving shipments every 2 weeks, monthly, or every 2 months at a 10%
discount. We'll automatically bill the credit card you provide us whenever we send a shipment. If
you would like to change the credit card we have on file, you can do so by logging in to your
account and editing your billing information or by contacting us at dtc@ripplefoods.com

### Ordering FAQs

What are my shipping options?

We currently have three shipping options you can choose from!

1) Standard (3 - 7 business days, $5 flat rate shipping)
2) Expedited (2-5 business days, the rate will be calculated at checkout)
3) Priority (1-4 business days, the rate will be calculated at checkout)

Looks like you're out of stock... 

We are doing our best to maintain a steady supply of Ripple products for our online store. If we are
out of something, we are working as fast as we can to re-stock.

You can also now sign up for back in stock announcements! Put your email address into the product
you would like updates on, and we will be sure to email you as soon as we have more products
available for purchase. 

What is the status of my order?

After you’ve made a purchase, we'll send you two emails. First, your 'Order Confirmation' email will
be sent within minutes of placing the order to let you know that our system has accepted your order.
As soon as your order is on its way, you will receive a 'Shipping Confirmation' email with all the
necessary tracking information. If you don’t see a confirmation email in your inbox, please check
your SPAM folder. If you still have questions about your order status, feel free to email us at
DTC@ripplefoods.com.

Can I make changes to my order?

Due to all Ripple orders being processed immediately after an order is submitted, we cannot
guarantee any updates to your order after it has been confirmed. In rare cases if a mistake has
occurred, please email us at DTC@ripplefoods.com as soon as you can to increase the chances we are
able to make updates before the warehouse starts working on your shipment! 

Orders are processed at our warehouse 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Processing generally takes
24-48 hours; once your order has shipped from the warehouse, please allow 2-3 business days for your
delicious Ripple to arrive at your door

What is your refund policy?

We don't accept returns of product or product exchanges.

If your order was damaged in transit, or if you've received the wrong Ripple order, please reach out
to our customer service team by email: dtc@ripplefoods.com.

If you believe there is a quality issue with your Ripple order, please take note of the code and the
"best by" date printed on the bottle or carton, so that we can trace the specific batch of Ripple
you have received. These inquiries will be handled on a case-by-case basis.

What is a Ripple Subscription?

We offer ongoing subscriptions to customers who never want to run out of Ripple! Our subscriptions
are commitment-free and can be updated, edited, or canceled at any point in time.

To sign up, select the "subscription" option on the product page before checking out.

You have the option of receiving shipments every 2 weeks, monthly, or every 2 months at a 10%
discount. We'll automatically bill the credit card you provide us whenever we send a shipment. If
you would like to change the credit card we have on file, you can do so by logging in to your
account and editing your billing information or by contacting us at dtc@ripplefoods.com

***The History of Farming***
Farming, the backbone of human civilization, has a history that dates back over 10,000 years to the
Neolithic Revolution. This period marked the transition from nomadic hunter-gatherer societies to
settled agricultural communities. Early farming began in the Fertile Crescent, a region spanning
modern-day Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Israel, and Jordan, where humans first domesticated crops like
wheat, barley, and legumes. The development of farming allowed for food surpluses, which supported
population growth and the rise of complex societies. Over centuries, farming techniques evolved with
the invention of tools like the plow, irrigation systems, and crop rotation. The Industrial
Revolution in the 18th and 19th centuries brought mechanization, transforming agriculture into a
more efficient and large-scale enterprise. Today, farming continues to evolve with advancements in
biotechnology, precision agriculture, and sustainable practices, ensuring food security for a
growing global population.

***The History of Livestock Farming***
Livestock farming, the practice of raising animals for meat, milk, wool, and labor, has been
integral to human societies since the dawn of agriculture. The domestication of animals such as
cattle, sheep, goats, and pigs began around 10,000 years ago, coinciding with the rise of crop
farming. Early livestock farming provided a reliable source of protein, materials for clothing, and
draft animals for plowing fields. Over time, selective breeding improved the quality and

***The History of Farming***
Farming, the backbone of human civilization, has a history that dates back over 10,000 years to the
Neolithic Revolution. This period marked the transition from nomadic hunter-gatherer societies to
settled agricultural communities. Early farming began in the Fertile Crescent, a region spanning
modern-day Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Israel, and Jordan, where humans first domesticated crops like
wheat, barley, and legumes. The development of farming allowed for food surpluses, which supported
population growth and the rise of complex societies. Over centuries, farming techniques evolved with
the invention of tools like the plow, irrigation systems, and crop rotation. The Industrial
Revolution in the 18th and 19th centuries brought mechanization, transforming agriculture into a
more efficient and large-scale enterprise. Today, farming continues to evolve with advancements in
biotechnology, precision agriculture, and sustainable practices, ensuring food security for a
growing global population.

***The History of Livestock Farming***
Livestock farming, the practice of raising animals for meat, milk, wool, and labor, has been
integral to human societies since the dawn of agriculture. The domestication of animals such as
cattle, sheep, goats, and pigs began around 10,000 years ago, coinciding with the rise of crop
farming. Early livestock farming provided a reliable source of protein, materials for clothing, and
draft animals for plowing fields. Over time, selective breeding improved the quality and
productivity of livestock. The Middle Ages saw the establishment of specialized farming systems,
such as pastoralism and mixed farming. The 20th century brought significant advancements in
veterinary medicine, nutrition, and breeding techniques, leading to increased efficiency and
production. However, modern livestock farming faces challenges related to environmental
sustainability, animal welfare, and climate change, prompting innovations in alternative proteins
and regenerative farming practices.

***The History of Poultry Farming***
Poultry farming, the raising of domesticated birds such as chickens, ducks, turkeys, and geese for
meat and eggs, has a rich history that spans thousands of years. Chickens, originally domesticated
in Southeast Asia around 6000 BCE, were initially valued for cockfighting and religious rituals
before their culinary importance was recognized. By the Roman Empire, poultry farming had become a
well-established practice, with chickens and eggs becoming dietary staples. The Industrial
Revolution marked a turning point, as technological advancements enabled large-scale production and
the development of specialized breeds for meat and egg production. The 20th century saw the rise of
intensive poultry farming, characterized by confined housing systems and automated feeding. Today,
poultry farming is a global industry, providing affordable protein to billions. However, it faces
scrutiny over animal welfare, antibiotic use, and environmental impact, driving demand for
free-range and organic alternatives.

***The History of Food Industries***
The food industry, encompassing the production, processing, packaging, and distribution of food, has
evolved dramatically over centuries. In ancient times, food processing was limited to basic methods
like drying, salting, and fermenting to preserve perishable items. The advent of agriculture allowed
for the cultivation of staple crops, which became the foundation of early food trade. The Industrial
Revolution in the 18th and 19th centuries revolutionized the food industry with innovations like
canning, refrigeration, and mechanized milling. The 20th century saw the rise of mass production,
convenience foods, and global supply chains, transforming how food is produced and consumed. Today,
the food industry is a multi-trillion-dollar sector, driven by technological advancements, consumer
demand for diverse and healthy options, and sustainability concerns. However, it also faces
challenges such as food waste, nutritional disparities, and the environmental impact of large-scale
production.

***The History of the Dairy Industry***
The dairy industry, centered on the production and processing of milk and its by-products, has a
history that dates back to the domestication of cattle around 8000 BCE. Early dairy farming was
practiced in regions like the Middle East and South Asia, where milk was consumed fresh or processed
into cheese, butter, and yogurt. The Middle Ages saw the establishment of dairy as a staple in
European diets, with monasteries playing a key role in advancing cheese-making techniques. The 19th
century brought significant innovations, including pasteurization, which improved milk safety, and
the invention of mechanical milking machines. The 20th century marked the industrialization of dairy
farming, with the rise of large-scale operations and the development of products like powdered milk
and ice cream. Today, the dairy industry is a global enterprise, but it faces challenges related to
lactose intolerance, environmental concerns, and the growing popularity of plant-based alternatives,
driving innovation in sustainable practices and dairy-free products.

## Taking action for the future

As Arla farmers, we are dependent on nature and recognise our role in relation to climate change.
That’s why we are taking steps to develop how we farm and produce dairy for you and your family.

We work together to support ongoing improvements, including actions related to greenhouse gas
emissions and biodiversity. Want to know more?

[Get the full story][19]

## Rewarding farmers for climate-related actions

From August 2023, Arla farmers who implement activities related to greenhouse gas emissions can be
rewarded through the FarmAhead™ Incentive.

Together with our farmer owners, we have set a target to reduce CO2e emissions from milk and whey by
30.3 per cent by 2030. Rewarding farmers for implementing these activities is part of our approach
to supporting actions on farm.

In total, up to 500 million euro is allocated to support payments to Arla farmers for activities
included in the model, based on the current milk pool.

[Read more about FarmAhead™ Incentive][20]
[Rewarding farmers for climate-related actions]

## Committed to limiting global warming to 1.5°C

In December 2021, we doubled our climate target for operations including owned logistics from 30 to
63 per cent. This target has been approved by the Science Based Targets initiative as consistent
with reductions required in scopes 1 and 2 to keep global warming to 1.5°C. [The most ambitious goal
of the Paris Agreement][21].

[Learn more about our commitment to 1.5°C][22]
[Committed to limiting global warming to 1.5°C]

## Data-driven climate action

Arla farmers are working hard on making dairy more sustainable. Together, we are working towards
reducing the carbon footprint from milk and whey by 30.3% by 2030*.

To support them on the journey, we've created one of the **world’s largest externally
validated** **climate data sets** from dairy farms to help our farmer owners become as climate
efficient as possible.

**From a 2020 baseline*

[Learn more][23]
[Data-driven climate action]

### Darey Brands ™

 

Darey Brands, Inc. is the parent company of leading specialty dairy brands: [Green Valley®][23] and
[Meyenberg®][24]. Our branded and private label products are sold nationwide at leading grocery,
mass, natural, specialty, and online retailers. Production occurs at multiple sites, yet primarily
in Sebastopol and Turlock, California. We also manufacture premium, plant-based dairy alternatives.
Darey Brands is wholly owned by Emmi Group, headquartered in Switzerland.

[darey-brands-girl-milk-1x1]

### What We Do

 

We are a national leader in sustainable and better-for-you specialty dairy. Our focus is on growing
innovative brands that offer consumers a broad range of product benefits— from environmentally
sustainable to easily digestible, nutrient-rich, and indulgent.

 

 

### What’s in a name?

 

Our founders were innovative pioneers in healthy eating and sustainable agriculture long before
these ideas became center-stage movements. Our name, **Darey Brands**, is not only a play on words,
but also a nod to our heritage and ethos. We proudly craft **Dairy That Dares to Be Different™.**

## Our Brands and Services

[Darey Brands: Brand Green Valley Lactose Free 2]
Green Valley Lactose Free
A full range of lactose-free dairy made from cow’s milk—perfect for sensitive digestion without
compromising on taste. From creamy yogurt and probiotic kefir to smooth sour cream, butter, and
cheese varieties like cream cheese and cottage cheese. Enjoy all the goodness of dairy, now easier
to digest. Naturally delicious, lactose-free.
[ Learn more ][25]
[Darey Brands: Brand Meyenberg 2]
Meyenberg
America's favorite goat milk brand since 1934. Products include fluid, powdered and evaporated milk
and delicious goat milk butter. We source our fresh milk from over 25 Certified Humane® California
dairies. Our dairy farm relationships built over the last several decades allow us to serve the
highest quality goat milk, and give access to the millions of people who love it.
[ Learn more ][26]
[Darey Brands Co-Packing]
Co-Packing and Private Label
With over a decade of expertise in crafting delicious plant-based dairy alternatives, Darey Brands
is your go-to partner for co-manufacturing and private label opportunities. We are here to develop
your ideal product — tailored to your needs, supported by our experience.
[ Learn more ][27]

October, 2024 | Company News Great Place To Work Certification™

### What We Do

 

We are a national leader in sustainable and better-for-you specialty dairy. Our focus is on growing
innovative brands that offer consumers a broad range of product benefits— from environmentally
sustainable to easily digestible, nutrient-rich, and indulgent.

 

 

### What’s in a name?

 

Our founders were innovative pioneers in healthy eating and sustainable agriculture long before
these ideas became center-stage movements. Our name, **Darey Brands**, is not only a play on words,
but also a nod to our heritage and ethos. We proudly craft **Dairy That Dares to Be Different™.**

[Darey Brands: Brand Green Valley Lactose Free 2]
Green Valley Lactose Free
A full range of lactose-free dairy made from cow’s milk—perfect for sensitive digestion without
compromising on taste. From creamy yogurt and probiotic kefir to smooth sour cream, butter, and
cheese varieties like cream cheese and cottage cheese. Enjoy all the goodness of dairy, now easier
to digest. Naturally delicious, lactose-free.
[ Learn more ][25]

Meyenberg
America's favorite goat milk brand since 1934. Products include fluid, powdered and evaporated milk
and delicious goat milk butter. We source our fresh milk from over 25 Certified Humane® California
dairies. Our dairy farm relationships built over the last several decades allow us to serve the
highest quality goat milk, and give access to the millions of people who love it.

## Learn how to eat real food and live a healthier life ... without going broke!

My husband and I started our marriage off in a great deal of debt. God saw us through that trial and
has challenged us to share what we’ve learned about finance, food and natural living with others who
struggle in this area. Why listen to me? I don't have letters after my name. I'm not a doctor, I
make mistakes and I burn dinner too. But I've been in the trenches and I know what it's like to need
help and not even know where to even begin. I figured my way out and learned lessons along the way.
This blog IS the lessons, and it's my goal for you to not be in those trenches alone without a way
to get out.

[hands holding berries under running water]
[Start Your Journey][62]

Struggle to afford healthy food? Learn the exact system I use to feed my family of 4 real food for
$350/month (including organic foods and grass-fed meat) in my signature course Grocery Budget
Bootcamp. Enrollment opens twice a year!

# Forager Project

## Now pouring

Dairy-free creamers made for real coffee lovers

[ Our foods ][36]
[ Find us ][37]
[Forager Cinnamon Vanilla creamer being poured into a glass of iced coffee.]
There’s a better way

## Our food philosophy is simple

Our mission is to make food make sense by making amazing dairy-free yogurt, milk and creamers that
are good for you, our planet and our future.

[ Our story ][38]

## Explore our foods

## What we stand for

We challenge dairy norms—because better food, and better business, should move the world forward.
Dairy from plants does.
* Organic
* Vegan
* Soy free
* Dairy free
* Gluten free
* BPA free

## Simple ingredients

It starts with the cashew—naturally creamy, resource-smart, and lower in saturated fat. Exactly what
dairy needs now.

[ Enjoy simple ][45]
[Stephen Williamson in his garden]

## Always organic
* — Protects natural resources
* — Builds soil health
* — Supports biodiversity

[ Dig in ][46]
[Cashew fruits hanging from a tree with green leaves.]

## Plants not cows

With cashews, coconuts, and curiosity, we’re foraging a new path for dairy, free from cows.

[ Discover dairy different ][47]
[Sunrise over a mountain landscape with a path leading towards the sun.]

## One small step

From people to packaging, each step we take moves us forward to living planet healthy, and with you
by our side, there’s no limit to the difference we can make.

[ Forage ahead ][48]

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

into a single forecast you can act on.

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

Go Dairy Free is the leading informational website for dairy-free recipes, product reviews, news,
restaurants, and health guides to aide those with milk allergies, lactose intolerance or a general
need or desire to live without dairy. Dairy-free includes milk-free, lactose-free, casein-free and
whey-free. We also offer resources for gluten-free, soy-free, food allergy, vegan and paleo diets.
Please note that ingredients, processes and products are subject to change by a manufacturer at any
time. All foods and products should be considered at risk for cross-contamination with milk and
other allergens. Always contact the manufacturer prior to consumption. And always consult a
physician before any change in diet.

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

* Corporate Development

## Testimonials

See customer stories
[Ben Rapaport]

“I don't know what the secret sauce is, but there are definitely names that showed up on Inven that
didn't show up on other platforms.”

Ben Rapaport

specific company is not on the list. With Inven, we are confident this won't happen.”

“Inven completely opens up the proprietary off-market world for us. List-building and outreach are
so much faster with Inven that it’s hard to quantify.”

Craig McNally
Managing Partner, Desert Horizon Capital
See customer stories

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

# ***The* Prosoya Advantage**

#### **ProSoya Inc.** is a world leader in the **design, development and manufacture of plant,
#### equipment and machines** using advanced technology & know-how **for dairy alternatives like
#### soya milk, almond milk, oat milk, soya protein isolate and many more…** Based on our **
#### expertise and experience in extraction, formulation and dehydration technology,** ProSoya is a
#### complete solution provider for all your ** non dairy production needs, formulated beverages,
#### concentrates and powders.**

## ***About* Us**

ProSoya offers the best in dairy alternative technology through continual innovation and R & D, and
by building world class equipment to achieve the best quality product to meet the needs of the
customer and the consumer.

ProSoya technology employs a patented process that produces a smooth neutral tasting nutritionally
superior extract, which provides a flexible base for a variety of great tasting beverages. Our
dehydration technology is not only the most efficient but also produces one of the finest quality of
concentrates and instant powders.

With over 30 years of experience we are a perfect partner to your business. A partner you can trust
for quality and reliability, and that’s an advantage you will need to stay ahead of the competition…
The ProSoya Advantage.
 

## ***Research &* Development**

ProSoya’s success stems from continuing research and development complimented with exhaustive
testing and demonstration capability. In addition we have in-house facilities for product
development and trials runs supported by a team of highly experienced and motivated personnel. Our
Research and Development Centre is equipped with fully automated systems for extraction,
formulation, evaporation and drying technology where our customers can get a hand on experience of
what we offer.
 

### ***Our demonstration/testing facility has the following capabilities:***
* Dairy alternative extraction and processing technology for capacity up to 1000 l/hr of extract
  followed by blending, formulation, homogenization, UHT Sterilization and aseptic brick type
  packaging systems.
* Okara drying system (spin flash dryer).
* Evaporation system (for concentrates).
* Multi stage spray drying system (for powders).
* Aroma recovery system.
* Herbal extraction system (for instant herbal powders).

### ***Dairy Alternative Beverage Know-How***

ProSoya can assist you in producing great tasting beverages using the ProSoya Process. This unique
state-of-the-art patented technology utilizing airless cold grinding which prevents oxidation
related nutrition degradation, and flavor and mouth-feel problems. It’s the same technology that
established some of the best selling soymilk brands, including Silk in USA, SoNice in Canada,
SoyaTnuva in Israel and Staeta in India. Our improved beverages have smooth mouth-feel, outstanding
non-beany taste and excellent formulation to appeal to discriminating palate. Our juice-soy beverage
and smoothie formulations with up to 7 g protein per 250 ml serving have absolutely no soy taste.
Creamsicle (Unilever Trademark) like taste of Creamy Orange is loved by mainstream consumers of all
ages. We have now added great tasting Peach Mango and Pineapple Banana smoothies. These are hit at
any party, with or without added sodas or/and alcohol. Also, we have traditional formulations:
Original or Plain, Vanilla, Chocolate, Mocha, Orange Shake, Strawberry Shake, etc..

## ## ***Our* Customers**

ProSoya technology is currently being used in more than **50 countries**. Our customers include
**DuPont, Kraft, Soya World, SunOpta, Unilever, Hershey’s and many more.**. Many bestselling brands,
including **Silk in the US, SoNice in Canada, SoyaTnuva in Israel and Staeta in India** have been
established using ProSoya’s patented technology and know-how. There are large-scale processing
plants in **Bolivia, Canada, Germany, India, Iran, Israel, Russia and USA**. Over 1000 small, to
medium-scale plants are located all around the world.

## The protein and probiotics of Greek yogurt. Minus the dairy.

We culture the world’s creamiest soymilk to make a dairy-free yogurt with 12g+ protein, 4g fiber,
and billions of probiotics.

[Frame Border 6]
[ [Text graphic with the words 'Plain & Simple' in green, bold font on a white background.] ][26]
[Frame Border 6]
[ [Text graphic with the word "STRAWBERRY" written in large red letters.] ][27]

[photo]

## **The only dairy-free yogurt that can go
## spoon-for-spoon with Greek yogurt.**

[Frame Border 4]

## Made the way it should be.

Like Greek yogurt, we use the magic of cultures to transform milk into thick and tangy yogurt.

Only we start with dairy-free milk from whole, organic soybeans—earth's best plant protein.

🚫 No GMOs, no protein isolates, no oils, no artificial sweeteners, no nonsense.

## With billions of live and active cultures in each little cup.

We culture our yogurt with some of the most studied probiotic strains in the world, including *L.
bulgaricus*, *S. thermophilus*,* L. lactis, L. acidophilus*, and *B. lactis*.

They're proven to support your digestion, gut, and immune system.

## We believe food should heal our bodies and planet.

For thousands of years, human civilizations have turned to soybeans for powerful nutrition and
balance with the environment. That’s because they have some magical qualities:
* The King Of Plant Proteins
  
  Soybeans are the only plant high in complete, fully digestible protein—like dairy protein. That
  means: 
  
  (1) Soybeans are 40% protein—that's more protein-dense than an egg
  
  (2) They contain all 9 essential amino acids
  
  (3) Our bodies easily digest the protein in soybeans, as measured by near their perfect PDCAAS.
  
  Other plant milks are mostly carbohydrates and fat with little and lower quality protein.
  
  Plus, soybeans are full of gut-healthy fiber.
* In Harmony With Mother Nature
  
  When it comes to the planet, soybeans are givers not takers.
  
  Soybeans enrich soil with nitrogen, a nutrient essential for all life.
  
  And they do that while using using ~90% less land, water, and pollution than traditional dairy
  milk (J. Poore and T. Nemecek, 2018, OurWorldinData.org).
  
  We only use non-gmo, organic soybeans that are grown in harmony with the land, without synthetic
  fertilizers, pesticides, or herbicides.

We’re slowly rolling out and testing the new design for the Wholesalers Network website so if you
find a missing page or something not looking quite right then please let us know. We’ve also update

Why does **Wholesalers Network** offer this directory of wholesale companies for free?
We’re glad you asked. We understand that starting and running a business is hard work. It costs a
lot of money to design, build and promote a new website. With all the costs involved with running a
retail store, eBay or e-commerce business we wanted to provide you with a free directory of
wholesale merchandise and products. We’ve also operated online retail stores and know how
challenging it can be to find the right wholesaler.

## Wholesale sourcing and the evolving digital marketplace

Platforms like Wholesalers Network provide businesses with structured access to thousands of
suppliers across multiple categories, making it easier to discover products for both online and
offline sales. Such directories play an important role in the B2B ecosystem by helping entrepreneurs
and retailers connect with manufacturers, distributors, and dropshipping partners in a more
efficient way.

In wholesale commerce, success depends heavily on reliable sourcing, consistent supply chains, and
strong supplier relationships. Businesses that take the time to evaluate partners, compare pricing
structures, and test product quality are better positioned to scale sustainably and maintain healthy
profit margins over time.

For a deeper look at how buyers can verify credibility before they commit money or time, read [Trust
Signals in B2B Wholesale Sourcing vs New Online Casinos][144].

Within this broader ecosystem, platforms such as **[casinoer uden rofus][145]** reflect how diverse
online experiences have become, offering users additional ways to engage and relax during their free
time.

As the digital marketplace continues to expand, B2B platforms are becoming more than just
directories—they are evolving into ecosystems where information, logistics, and communication
intersect. This transformation allows businesses to operate more efficiently and adapt to changing
market demands with greater flexibility.

At the same time, the online environment is not limited to business and sourcing alone. Users
interact with a wide variety of platforms daily, combining work-related activities with
entertainment and leisure in a single digital space.

Ultimately, building a successful wholesale business requires a combination of smart sourcing
strategies, adaptability, and balance. By leveraging reliable directories while staying open to
broader digital trends, businesses can create sustainable growth in an increasingly connected world.

Do you list [wholesale dropship companies][146] on this website?
Yes. All companies that offer drop shipping are linked to the “[Dropshipper][147]” page of the
directory. See our article on dropshipping or eBay wholesalers for more information.

We also list wholesale distributors, manufacturers of products, trade only, end of line and closeout
merchandise, liquidators, distribution networks, b2b news, wholesale suppliers, importers,
exporters, transport, and logistics companies.

As digital markets continue to evolve, many businesses are looking beyond traditional wholesale and
retail models to identify new growth opportunities. The expansion of online ecosystems has created
entirely new sectors where partnerships, scalability, and global reach are essential components of
success.

In addition to physical goods and logistics networks, digital platforms now play a significant role
in shaping modern commerce. From subscription-based services to entertainment-driven platforms, the
structure of these industries often mirrors wholesale principles — connecting suppliers with end
users through efficient and scalable systems.

A notable example of this shift can be seen in the growth of international online entertainment
platforms. Concepts such as **[Online Casino utan spelpaus][148]** highlight how digital services
are expanding across borders, offering users alternative experiences while relying on strong backend
infrastructure, marketing strategies, and user acquisition models.

For entrepreneurs and business owners, understanding these parallel industries can provide valuable
insights into customer behavior, digital scaling strategies, and emerging global trends. Exploring
how different sectors operate can ultimately help businesses remain competitive and adaptable in an
increasingly interconnected marketplace.

suppliers across multiple categories, making it easier to discover products for both online and
offline sales. Such directories play an important role in the B2B ecosystem by helping entrepreneurs
and retailers connect with manufacturers, distributors, and dropshipping partners in a more
efficient way.

In wholesale commerce, success depends heavily on reliable sourcing, consistent supply chains, and
strong supplier relationships. Businesses that take the time to evaluate partners, compare pricing
structures, and test product quality are better positioned to scale sustainably and maintain healthy
profit margins over time.

Signals in B2B Wholesale Sourcing vs New Online Casinos][144].

directories—they are evolving into ecosystems where information, logistics, and communication
intersect. This transformation allows businesses to operate more efficiently and adapt to changing
market demands with greater flexibility.

interact with a wide variety of platforms daily, combining work-related activities with
entertainment and leisure in a single digital space.

Wilmersburger gefunden. Vielen Dank für Eure leckeren Scheiben, den Pizzaschmelz und überhaupt, dass
es Wilmersburger gibt."

Manufacturing models

## Three ways to make your product

### Private label

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

[Browse private label manufacturers ][42]

### White label

You select an existing product the manufacturer already produces and apply your branding. Use it
when speed and low MOQs matter more than uniqueness. The formula stays with the manufacturer and may
be sold to other brands in parallel, so you carry less development risk but accept that competitors
may shelve a near-identical product.

[Browse white label manufacturers ][43]

### Contract manufacturing

You hand the manufacturer a complete specification or formula and they produce it to order. Use it
when you have proprietary IP, regulated processes, or volumes that justify dedicated production. You
own the formula, the manufacturer owns the capacity, and the commercial terms are usually structured
around guaranteed minimum runs.

Manufacturing models

## Three ways to make your product

### Private label

You commission a manufacturer to produce a formula adapted to your brand, packaged under your name.
Use it when you want a differentiated product without owning a factory. The formula is typically
co-developed and can be licensed exclusively, with the manufacturer retaining process know-how and
you owning the brand and commercial rights.

[Browse private label manufacturers ][42]

### White label

You select an existing product the manufacturer already produces and apply your branding. Use it
when speed and low MOQs matter more than uniqueness. The formula stays with the manufacturer and may
be sold to other brands in parallel, so you carry less development risk but accept that competitors
may shelve a near-identical product.

[Browse white label manufacturers ][43]

### Contract manufacturing

You hand the manufacturer a complete specification or formula and they produce it to order. Use it
when you have proprietary IP, regulated processes, or volumes that justify dedicated production. You
own the formula, the manufacturer owns the capacity, and the commercial terms are usually structured
around guaranteed minimum runs.
